svg.title: Tangential and centripetal acceleration in circular motion
svg.desc: Velocity is tangent to the circular path. The tangential acceleration aₜ points along the tangent and changes speed; the perpendicular centripetal acceleration a꜀ points toward the center and changes the direction of velocity. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.
